title: scigrid-de: Monte Carlo storm-stress EENS (modelled outage probabilities, reduced 4 h horizon)

base_scenario.name: scigrid-de Monte Carlo storm-stress base (snapshots 0-3)
base_scenario.description: Base scenario for a StormRisk Monte Carlo study on the PyPSA SciGRID-DE example (reduced 4-snapshot horizon to keep runtime bounded). Load shedding at VOLL. Outages are sampled by StormRisk from the modelled distributions in 'sampling'.
assumptions: SciGRID-DE (PyPSA example, 2011 data) is a research model of the German transmission grid; results are not statements about the real German system.

outage_classes.name: lines-storm
outage_classes.source: MODELLED storm-stress assumption, not observed data. IEEE RTS-96 branch data (Grigg et al., 'The IEEE Reliability Test System-1996', IEEE Trans. Power Syst. 14(3):1010-1020, 1999, Table 12: permanent outage rate 0.24-0.54 /yr, duration 10-16 h) gives normal-weather q = lambda*r/8760 ~ 3e-4 to 1e-3; adverse-weather rates are modelled as one to two orders of magnitude higher (two-state weather model, Billinton & Allan, 'Reliability Evaluation of Power Systems', 2nd ed., 1996, ch. 7). q = 0.01 is an illustrative value in that envelope.

outage_classes.name: transformers
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: IEEE RTS-96 transformer branches (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 12: 0.02 outages/yr x 768 h) give q ~ 1.75e-3; rounded to 0.002 and not storm-scaled (substation equipment assumed less weather-exposed than overhead lines).

outage_classes.name: nuclear
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 generator reliability data (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 400 MW nuclear unit forced outage rate 0.12. Not German fleet statistics.

outage_classes.name: coal
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 350 MW coal/steam unit forced outage rate 0.08. Not German fleet statistics.

outage_classes.name: gas
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 has no gas units; the 197 MW oil/steam forced outage rate 0.05 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6) is used as a proxy for mid-size thermal plant.

outage_classes.name: oil
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 20 MW oil combustion turbine forced outage rate 0.10.
